correctness.rationale: The normal form of a minimum labelled n−2-colouring of KG(n,2) comprises exactly one triangle colour class on Q and one star class per S=[n]\Q; center-center edges independently choose an endpoint class. For any s,t∈S, recolouring {s,t} is an isolated Kempe component. A 6-spoke connected bichromatic component transposes center colours. Making a center a sink permits three two-vertex Kempe components to move one Q vertex into S. The constructed round trip then interchanges the triangle colour with any center colour while restoring Q, so Johnson connectivity and palette transpositions imply one Kempe class for n≥5; n=4 is three disjoint K2. Single-site moves only toggle center-center assignments; exact cube count C(n,3)(n−2)! with dimension C(n−3,2). Independently enumerated 8,120,3840 labelled optimal colourings for n=4,5,6 and computed actual Kempe component BFS, reaching all states; these finite cases only corroborate all-n constructive proof.
